title: Genshin Impact — Character Story
style_tags: Genshin Impact anime cel-shaded character art
tts_note: Genshin ALWAYS uses Chatterbox via fal-ai/chatterbox/text-to-speech. Voice refs at assets/genshin-impact/characters/{slug}/voice-1.mp3. Long monologue (>80 words) → mandatory chunking into ≤35-word segments (see sound.md §1b).

format_overrides.note: Format-level additions applied from EP9 (2026-06-29) onwards. Scenarist must implement these in storyboard.json.
format_overrides.hook_requirement: Clip 1 MUST visualize the most tragic or emotionally intense trial of the character — not a neutral opener. Visual should be scroll-stopping (dramatic contrast of light/dark, child alone, devastating loss). TTS fragment sets the stakes immediately.

promo_clip.tts_template_en: Grab free Primogems from the link in bio. Now — here's my story.
promo_clip.tts_template_ru: Забери бесплатные примагемы по ссылке в био. А вот моя история.
promo_clip.visual_note: Character faces camera in neutral/warm environment (Wangsheng gates, shrine entrance, etc). Slight knowing smile or direct gaze — as if speaking to the viewer. NOT dramatic — brief and natural, then cuts to story.

format_overrides.structure: HOOK (clip 1) → PROMO (clip 2) → ORIGIN (clips 3-4) → TURNING POINT (clips 5-6) → REVELATION (clip 7) → CTA

character_rotation.selection_note: Pick characters with strong lore arcs and tragic backstories. Prioritize 5-star characters with high popularity. Alternate male/female for variety. Avoid repeating characters used in dual-style within 4 episodes.

episode_summaries.idea: Furina — The Human Who Played an Archon for 500 Years | Character Story EP13 | Genshin Impact
episode_summaries.notes: 2 age variants (young_masquerade_start clips 3-4 / present clips 1,2,5-7); new reusable ref furina/variants/young-masquerade-2026-07-21.png. Hook = Focalors execution (Oratrice verdict); promo clip 2 with USER-OVERRIDDEN wording: "Get free Primogems — link in bio. And now... my story." (replaces bible tts_template_en for this ep). Monologue trimmed 99→77 words across 2 scenarist passes: Chatterbox delivery ran +47% vs 35s timeline; final per-clip atempo 1.18-1.30 (cap 1.4). Lesson: draft segments <=12 spoken words for Chatterbox 0.46-0.56 s/word.

episode_summaries.notes: 3 age variants (child ~9-10, young adult ~17, adult present). Ran as part of a 5-video parallel batch (Diluc/Arlecchino/Kaeya/Nahida/Venti) alongside sibling episodes 15-18. episode_summaries.idea: Nahida — The God Who Was Locked in Her Own Dream | Character Story EP17 | Genshin Impact
episode_summaries.notes: Single age variant (no distinct canonical child/adult designs). New character ref assets/genshin-impact/characters/nahida/variants/canonical-2026-08-06.png. Editor's first mix pass raised bg-music volume from the declared 0.15 to 0.45 (out of the format's 0.10-0.20 range) to fix inaudibility; caught in review, redone at the declared 0.15 with a 2-pass loudnorm on the overall mix instead (-14 LUFS), matching how the sibling episodes handled the same issue. Prior 0.45 mix archived at _archive/final-v1-vol045.mp4, not deleted. Part of the same 5-video parallel batch as EP14/15/16/18.

episode_summaries.idea: Ganyu — Secretary of the Liyue Qixing | Character Story
episode_summaries.notes: Single age variant (no distinct canonical child/adult design for Ganyu). New character ref assets/genshin-impact/characters/ganyu/variants/canonical-2026-08-11.png. Originally storyboarded/animated as 8 clips to absorb an oversized TTS (49.88s vs 35s, 42.5% mismatch); post-review the user flagged a 4-arm anatomy artifact on clip 6 (the insomnia/guilt beat) and asked for a more compact cut. Clip 6 was dropped entirely (its tts_segment removed, not replaced), the trailing two clips renumbered 6-7 reusing their original images/video unchanged, and TTS regenerated for the trimmed 79-word monologue (42.36s vs new 35s, 21% mismatch) — reassembled at the format's standard 7-clip/35s structure. Flawed scene-6 assets archived at build/_archive/scene-6-flawed-4arms, not deleted.
